en-GB.name: Hush: Don't Wake the Mimic
en-GB.subtitle: Open slowly. Steal the gold.
en-GB.description:
Your iPhone Duo is a treasure chest. The chest is a sleeping mimic.

Stand your Duo like a little laptop: the raised half is the lid. Open it slowly and the candlelight spills in, showing the gold. Drag the loot into your bag gently, then ease the lid shut to bank it. Too fast, and the lid creaks, the mimic wakes, and it bites.

The game where you have to be gentle.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts. No data collected. Pay once and it's yours.

SLOW HANDS WIN
- Open the lid slowly: the light reaches deeper into the chest as it opens
- Coins sit near the front, gems further back, and relics deep inside: open wide for those
- Drag gently: a fast drag rattles, and loot dropped outside the bag clunks
- Loot in your bag isn't safe yet. Ease the lid shut to bank it, and gently: closing fast is noisy too
- A bite costs everything in your bag and 10 seconds of candle

WATCH THE MIMIC
Every chest starts asleep. The noise meter on the chest floor fills when you move too fast and drains when you keep still. When the snoring stops, a slow heartbeat starts and the velvet tongue twitches, it's stirring. When the meter turns red and "Freeze!" appears, hold still and let it settle. Loot in your bag keeps a little noise in the air, so the more you carry, the less the mimic settles. Every mimic wears a name tag, and each has a habit: Snorers, Light Sleepers, Heavy Sleepers, and Dreamers who twitch in their sleep.

PUSH YOUR LUCK
Your candle burns down while you loot, and a flask of oil found in a chest buys six more seconds. The chests get richer as you go, from Wooden to Iron-bound, Gilded and Royal. When something glints deeper in, a relic is hiding at the back: open wider, or bank what you have? When the candle goes out the run ends, and anything still in your bag is lost.

HUSH CHAIN AND GOLDEN MIMICS
Bank a chest without the mimic ever stirring and it's Hushed. Hushed banks in a row build a Hush Chain, and each one pays more: gold ×1.1, ×1.2, up to ×1.5. One stir breaks the chain. Now and then a golden mimic turns up: it doubles a chest's gold, but it sleeps lighter.

DAILY DUNGEON
The same chests for everyone, every day, and one try that counts. Then practise as much as you like.

RELICS AND THIEF RANKS
Twenty-four named relics hide deep in the better chests, from the Moth-Eaten Crown to the Idol of the Sleepy God. Find each one once and it stays in your Relic Codex. Every coin you bank counts towards your thief rank: twelve ranks, from Pickpocket to Mimic Whisperer.

FIRST CHEST
Your first chest is a short lesson: open, grab, freeze, bank. Replay it from Settings any time.

MADE FOR THE FOLD. PLAYS ON EVERY iPhone.
On iPhone Duo the hinge is the lid, and how gently you move it is the whole skill: about two slow strokes per chest. You never need to lay the phone flat, close it or move it fast. Moving fast is how you lose. iPhone Duo softens one half of its screen for a moment when a fold starts, so Hush keeps the loot, the noise meter and every warning on the half that stays sharp, and shows you which half to lift. Fold the lid down past upright, or close the Duo, and the run pauses, candle and all. On any other iPhone, an on-screen lever opens and shuts the lid. Same chests, same mimic, same leaderboards, but on the Duo you feel the lid creak under your fingers.

SOUND AND FEEL
The creak follows your exact speed, in sound and in haptics. The snores, the heartbeat, the coin clinks, the cascade of a banked haul and the CHOMP are all synthesised live in the app. Every warning is shown on screen too, so you can play with the sound off. Sound plays on silent unless you switch that off, and Settings has switches for sound, haptics and Reduce motion.

GAME CENTER
Leaderboards for your Best Haul and the Daily Dungeon, and 12 achievements. It's optional: Hush works fully without signing in.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no tracking, no data collected. Your progress stays on your iPhone.
en-GB.promotionalText: Stand your iPhone Duo like a little laptop and lift the lid, slowly. Grab the gold, ease it shut to bank it, don't wake the mimic. Lever on other iPhones. No ads, no IAP.

review.notes:
Thanks for reviewing Hush: a paid game. No ads, IAP, accounts, data collection or network requests of its own.

1. TESTING WITHOUT AN iPHONE DUO (start here)
The full game works on any iPhone and in the Simulator, in portrait.
- The top half is the chest lid, the bottom half the floor with the loot.
- First launch opens First Chest, a short lesson (no score). Skip appears after step 2; Settings > Replay First Chest replays it.
- Open the lid with the LEVER on the top half: drag it up slowly to open, down to shut.
- Drag a lit coin or gem into the bag (IN BAG, at the bottom). Bagged loot is not safe yet.
- Slide the lever back down and hold a moment: the bag is banked (BANKED) and the next chest arrives.
- The NOISE meter fills if you move or drag fast and drains when you keep still. "Freeze!" means hold still. If it fills, the mimic bites: the bag is lost and the candle loses 10 seconds.
- The run ends when the candle burns out (100 s, +6 s per oil flask bagged).
- Every achievement can be earned with the lever.

2. THE HINGE (iPhone Duo)
Hush reads the hinge angle only through the public iOS 27.1 API (SwiftUI onHingeChange), behind an availability check. The angle never leaves the phone (only the last screen-switch angle is kept, for an on-device diagnostics panel). On a Duo the hinge is the lid; if iOS keeps it in landscape, "Play anyway" offers the lever.
a) Stand the Duo like a small laptop. The raised half is the lid; held like a book, a card shows which half to lift.
b) Shut is about 100 degrees, wide open about 165. Ease back to 110 or less and hold a moment to bank.
c) The skill is moving the hinge SLOWLY: fast movement makes noise. Movement below 97 or above 168 degrees makes none.
d) iOS briefly blurs one half of the inner screen when a fold starts, so Hush draws the chest turned round: the blurring half is the lid; loot and warnings stay on the sharp half. Settings > Turn the chest round switches this off.
e) PAUSE: below 70 degrees (for 0.4 s) play pauses: "Lift the lid a little to carry on". If iOS moves the app to the outer display first, that is a pause too (a sleeping-mimic card). While paused the candle stops and the noise is frozen.
f) RESUME: at 95 degrees or more (after the outer display: where the inner one lit, if lower) AND still (under 6 degrees/s for 0.3 s), on the inner display; until then "Hold still". Lid noise is ignored for 0.5 s after resuming, so reopening never bites.
g) Above 172 degrees: "That's wide enough" (no penalty).

3. KIND TO THE DEVICE (2.4.2, 1.4.5)
- Fast hinge movement is the losing move. About two slow strokes per chest, mid-range.
- Hush never asks the user to close the phone, lay it flat or move the hinge quickly. Opening past 165 gains nothing.
- No score, achievement or bonus rewards hinge speed or move count; the bonuses reward quiet play.
- Play reads the angle, never the closed state. Nothing is placed on the screens.

4. MODES
Run (until the candle burns out; Wooden, Iron-bound, Gilded, Royal chests; a rare golden mimic pays double); Daily Dungeon (the same chests for everyone that UTC day, one scored try, then practice); First Chest. Hush Chain: banks in a row where the mimic never stirred pay x1.1 up to x1.5. Relic Codex: 24 relics. 12 thief ranks.

5. CONTENT (9+)
A cartoon chest monster with one big eye. If the player is noisy it "bites": teeth snap shut across the fold with a comic CHOMP and a red flash. Nobody is hurt; the player loses the bag and 10 s of candle.

6. PRIVACY
No SDKs, analytics, ads, accounts or tracking. Progress stays on the device. Data Not Collected.

7. GAME CENTER
Optional. 2 leaderboards, 12 achievements (525 points), none hidden.

8. OTHER
- No notifications, no rating prompt. Debug and demo modes are compiled out of Release.
- Sound plays on silent; Settings > Play sound on silent turns that off. All sound is synthesized; every sound cue has an on-screen cue.
- Settings > Reduce motion (or iOS Reduce Motion) removes the shake and red flash.

nomination.name: Hush - App Launch - iPhone Duo hinge-speed stealth
nomination.description:
Hush turns iPhone Duo into a treasure chest, and the chest is a sleeping mimic. Stand the Duo like a little laptop: the raised half is the lid. Open it slowly and candlelight spills in to show the gold; drag the loot into your bag gently, then ease the lid shut to bank it. Too fast, and the lid creaks, the mimic wakes and it bites.

It is the first game we know of that scores how slowly you move the hinge. The game reads how fast you move the lid, and the creak in your speaker and your fingers follows it exactly, so being gentle is the whole challenge, and the losing move is the one that is hard on a hinge.

Push-your-luck runs of about two minutes against a burning candle, chests that get richer from Wooden to Royal, golden mimics worth double, a Hush Chain that pays more for sleepy banks in a row, a Daily Dungeon with the same chests for everyone, a 24-relic Codex and Game Center. Every other iPhone plays with an on-screen lever. No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected.
nomination.notes: Optimized for iPhone Duo: built for tabletop pose on the inner display. iOS blurs one half of the screen when a fold starts, so Hush draws the chest turned round: the loot and warnings stay on the sharp half. Closing or folding past upright pauses the run; it resumes only once the lid is open and still. Public iOS 27.1 hinge API; never asks for flat, closed or fast. A First Chest lesson teaches by doing. All sound synthesized. Also from us: Squish, Brim and Swoop.
